say:1:1660216001:1.text: When your eyes open again, snow is falling. It glitters against a sky as dark as velvet.
say:1:1660216001:1.source_cn: 再睁开双眼时，冬日的雪花映入眼帘闪闪，点缀着长夜的幕布。
say:1:1660216001:1.male: When your eyes open again, snow is falling. It glitters against a sky as dark as velvet.
say:1:1660216001:1.female: When your eyes open again, snow is falling. It glitters against a sky as dark as velvet.

say:2:1660216002:1.text: You all push forward through the snowstorm. Soren leads at the front, and you take the rear, keeping Ludovic and Rowan safely between you.
say:2:1660216002:1.source_cn: 你们一行人正顶风冒雪，正在无边的暴风雪中前进。索恩位于...
say:2:1660216002:1.male: You all push forward through the snowstorm. Soren leads at the front, and you take the rear, keeping Ludovic and Rowan safely between you.
say:2:1660216002:1.female: You all push forward through the snowstorm. Soren leads at the front, and you take the rear, keeping Ludovic and Rowan safely between you.

say:3:1660216003:1.text: Everyone shields their face from the biting wind. Heads down, they follow each other's footsteps, one at a time.
say:3:1660216003:1.source_cn: 所有人都把手臂挡在脸前方，不去直面那刀子似的寒风。低着...

say:5:1660216004:0.text: Where even are we...? This storm's insane!
say:5:1660216004:0.source_cn: 我们这是、到什么地方来了……暴风雪刮得好厉害！

say:6:1660216005:1.text: Rowan has to shout just to be heard, and even then, the wind swallows his words.
say:6:1660216005:1.source_cn: 罗万几乎是在大喊了，即便如此，他的声音听起来也断断续续...

say:8:1660216006:0.text: You wouldn't guess it, but this is someone's dream, too.
say:8:1660216006:0.source_cn: 你也许难以置信，这里是另一个人的梦境。

say:9:1660216007:0.text: Who even dreams of a snowstorm like this?!
say:9:1660216007:0.source_cn: 谁的梦里，会是这样的暴风雪啊！

choice_prompt:10:1660216007.text: Who even dreams of a snowstorm like this?!
choice_prompt:10:1660216007.source_cn: 谁的梦里，会是这样的暴风雪啊！

say:14:1660216010:0.text: That joke was drier than this barren land!
say:14:1660216010:0.source_cn: 你的笑话比这暴风雪还要冷！
say:14:1660216010:0.male: That joke was drier than this barren land!
say:14:1660216010:0.female: That joke was drier than this barren land!

say:15:1660216011:1.text: Suddenly, Soren comes to a stop. You step forward and notice the grave look on his face.
say:15:1660216011:1.source_cn: 突然间，索恩停了下来。你走上前，发现他的面色十分凝重。
say:15:1660216011:1.male: Suddenly, Soren comes to a stop. You step forward and notice the grave look on his face.
say:15:1660216011:1.female: Suddenly, Soren comes to a stop. You step forward and notice the grave look on his face.

say:17:1660216013:1.text: Rowan catches up and squints at the endless white, but finds nothing.
say:17:1660216013:1.source_cn: 罗万也赶上前，在白茫茫一片的雪地里仔细分辨了一会儿，但...

say:18:1660216014:1.text: You look down, but all you see is snow. There's nothing to make sense of.
say:18:1660216014:1.source_cn: 你看向地面，到处都是积雪，什么都看不出来。
say:18:1660216014:1.male: You look down, but all you see is snow. There's nothing to make sense of.
say:18:1660216014:1.female: You look down, but all you see is snow. There's nothing to make sense of.

say:19:1660216015:1.text: Then we keep moving... Fate might guide us where we need to go.
say:19:1660216015:1.source_cn: 事已至此，我们便继续向前吧……命运会引领我们走向应许之处。

choice_prompt:20:1660216015.text: Then we keep moving... Fate might guide us where we need to go.
choice_prompt:20:1660216015.source_cn: 事已至此，我们便继续向前吧……命运会引领我们走向应许之处。

say:21:1660216016:1.text: Soren nods and starts walking again.
say:21:1660216016:1.source_cn: 索恩听到你的话，沉默地点点头。引着你们继续向前。
say:21:1660216016:1.male: Soren nods and starts walking again.
say:21:1660216016:1.female: Soren nods and starts walking again.

say:22:1660216018:1.text: The snowstorm doesn't let up. If anything, the wind howls louder, and the snow piles up.
say:22:1660216018:1.source_cn: 暴风雪还在刮个不停，你感觉风好像越来越大了，雪也积得更厚。
say:22:1660216018:1.male: The snowstorm doesn't let up. If anything, the wind howls louder, and the snow piles up.
say:22:1660216018:1.female: The snowstorm doesn't let up. If anything, the wind howls louder, and the snow piles up.

say:23:1660216019:0.text: It's disorienting. One moment the wind is at your back, the next it slams you sideways. You're not even sure you're still heading forward.
say:23:1660216019:0.source_cn: 你感觉自己似乎不是在向前行走，时而顺风、时而逆风；有时...
say:23:1660216019:0.male: It's disorienting. One moment the wind is at your back, the next it slams you sideways. You're not even sure you're still heading forward.
say:23:1660216019:0.female: It's disorienting. One moment the wind is at your back, the next it slams you sideways. You're not even sure you're still heading forward.

say:25:1660216020:0.text: A sudden gust blasts snow into your face, blinding you. When your vision clears, Ludovic is gone!
say:25:1660216020:0.source_cn: 随着一阵狂风卷着雪而来，迷住了你的双眼。再睁开，你突然...
say:25:1660216020:0.male: A sudden gust blasts snow into your face, blinding you. When your vision clears, Ludovic is gone!
say:25:1660216020:0.female: A sudden gust blasts snow into your face, blinding you. When your vision clears, Ludovic is gone!

choice_prompt:26:1660216020.text: A sudden gust blasts snow into your face, blinding you. When your vision clears, Ludovic is gone!
choice_prompt:26:1660216020.source_cn: 随着一阵狂风卷着雪而来，迷住了你的双眼。再睁开，你突然发现前方的柳博米尔不见了！
choice_prompt:26:1660216020.male: A sudden gust blasts snow into your face, blinding you. When your vision clears, Ludovic is gone!
choice_prompt:26:1660216020.female: A sudden gust blasts snow into your face, blinding you. When your vision clears, Ludovic is gone!

say:27:1660216021:1.text: You shout Ludovic's name at the top of your lungs.
say:27:1660216021:1.source_cn: 你大声呼喊柳博米尔的名字
say:27:1660216021:1.male: You shout Ludovic's name at the top of your lungs.
say:27:1660216021:1.female: You shout Ludovic's name at the top of your lungs.

say:30:1660216024:0.text: Only then do you notice Ludovic standing just a few steps away, watching you with a puzzled look. You reflect on the panic you just felt...
say:30:1660216024:0.source_cn: 你这才发现，柳博米尔就在你五六步远的地方，正有些奇怪地...
say:30:1660216024:0.male: Only then do you notice Ludovic standing just a few steps away, watching you with a puzzled look. You reflect on the panic you just felt...
say:30:1660216024:0.female: Only then do you notice Ludovic standing just a few steps away, watching you with a puzzled look. You reflect on the panic you just felt...

choice_prompt:31:1660216024.text: Only then do you notice Ludovic standing just a few steps away, watching you with a puzzled look. You reflect on the panic you just felt...
choice_prompt:31:1660216024.source_cn: 你这才发现，柳博米尔就在你五六步远的地方，正有些奇怪地看着你。你回想起刚才惊慌的感觉……
choice_prompt:31:1660216024.male: Only then do you notice Ludovic standing just a few steps away, watching you with a puzzled look. You reflect on the panic you just felt...
choice_prompt:31:1660216024.female: Only then do you notice Ludovic standing just a few steps away, watching you with a puzzled look. You reflect on the panic you just felt...

say:32:1660216025:0.text: You've been through worse. Much worse. And yet this dream is getting under your skin! That shouldn't be happening!
say:32:1660216025:0.source_cn: 你觉得这很不对劲，你经历过那么多的险境，不该这么简单就...
say:32:1660216025:0.male: You've been through worse. Much worse. And yet this dream is getting under your skin! That shouldn't be happening!
say:32:1660216025:0.female: You've been through worse. Much worse. And yet this dream is getting under your skin! That shouldn't be happening!

say:34:1660216026:0.text: With your warning, the others begin to realize the same strange feeling rising from within themselves.
say:34:1660216026:0.source_cn: 在你的提醒下，众人也纷纷意识到了这种来自心中的异常感。
say:34:1660216026:0.male: With your warning, the others begin to realize the same strange feeling rising from within themselves.
say:34:1660216026:0.female: With your warning, the others begin to realize the same strange feeling rising from within themselves.

say:35:1660216027:0.text: Yeah... that would explain it. All this despair and negativity we're feeling—it's not just the cold. The winter curse must be getting to us.
say:35:1660216027:0.source_cn: 的确，我们应该也受到了冬日诅咒的影响，才会这样沮丧和消极。

say:36:1660216028:0.text: I've traveled across deserts and warzones just to make a trade. And now I'm ready to give up because of a snowstorm? That's not me.
say:36:1660216028:0.source_cn: 对啊，我到处行商，经历的事情那么多，怎么会被一场暴风雪...

say:37:1660216029:0.text: The curse is getting worse. If we don't move faster, it'll bury us before the snow does.
say:37:1660216029:0.source_cn: 诅咒正在变强，我们需要加快脚步了。

say:38:1660216030:0.text: As everyone starts to snap out of it, the wind doesn't feel quite as harsh. The snowstorm is still there, but it's easing up.
say:38:1660216030:0.source_cn: 随着大家振奋精神，一刻不停的寒风竟然不再那么凛冽了，暴...

say:40:1660216032:1.text: You look to where Soren is pointing. The horizon opens, and the dark sky suddenly disappears like a pulled-back curtain.
say:40:1660216032:1.source_cn: 你们顺着索恩指着的方向看过去，地平线变得开阔，黑暗低垂...
say:40:1660216032:1.male: You look to where Soren is pointing. The horizon opens, and the dark sky suddenly disappears like a pulled-back curtain.
say:40:1660216032:1.female: You look to where Soren is pointing. The horizon opens, and the dark sky suddenly disappears like a pulled-back curtain.

say:41:1660216033:1.text: A small cabin appears in the distance, tucked into the snow. It looks cozy, almost like it's been waiting for you.
say:41:1660216033:1.source_cn: 你们突然发现，在你们的前方，出现了一座雪中小屋。它可爱...
say:41:1660216033:1.male: A small cabin appears in the distance, tucked into the snow. It looks cozy, almost like it's been waiting for you.
say:41:1660216033:1.female: A small cabin appears in the distance, tucked into the snow. It looks cozy, almost like it's been waiting for you.

say:44:1660216022:1.text: You stop and look around, trying to find any trace of the others.
say:44:1660216022:1.source_cn: 你停下脚步，站在原地四处张望，试图寻找其他人的身影。
say:44:1660216022:1.male: You stop and look around, trying to find any trace of the others.
say:44:1660216022:1.female: You stop and look around, trying to find any trace of the others.

say:45:1660216017:1.text: Soren nods and steps aside, letting you take the lead. The others follow.
say:45:1660216017:1.source_cn: 索恩听到你的话，沉默地点点头。换了你引着大家继续向前。
say:45:1660216017:1.male: Soren nods and steps aside, letting you take the lead. The others follow.
say:45:1660216017:1.female: Soren nods and steps aside, letting you take the lead. The others follow.

choice:10:0:1.text: Maybe someone with a heart of ice.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 也许是一个冷若冰霜的人吧
choice:10:0:1.male: Maybe someone with a heart of ice.
choice:10:0:1.female: Maybe someone with a heart of ice.

choice:10:1:2.text: Maybe a frozen fish locked in a cellar.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 也许是冰窖里的冻鱼吧
choice:10:1:2.male: Maybe a frozen fish locked in a cellar.
choice:10:1:2.female: Maybe a frozen fish locked in a cellar.
